are_you_ok.title: First responders warn of continued fire risk despite some downgraded fire restrictions
are_you_ok.summary: Clear Creek County, a small mountain county about 30 miles southwest of Boulder, along with Jefferson and Arapahoe counties, the suburbs south and southeast of Boulder, and Ouray County, a rural mountain county about 250 miles southwest, are under stage 1 fire restrictions. Pitkin County, a mountain county about 110 miles southwest, and Gilpin County, a small mountain county about 20 miles southwest, are set to roll their restrictions back.
questions: Are the fire restrictions affecting anything close to home?
How has the fire risk around Boulder felt this season?
Have smoke or fire conditions changed any weekend plans?
are_you_ok.description: Clear Creek, Jefferson, Arapahoe and Ouray counties are under stage 1 restrictions as of this weekend. Pitkin and Gilpin counties are set to roll back by Friday.

you_should_know.title: Boulder’s Spruce Pool will stay open in 2027. After that, its future is unclear.
you_should_know.summary: One-time funding will keep the longtime gathering place in Whittier, a neighborhood just northeast of downtown Boulder, open for the 2027 season, but the city says no ongoing funding is available for 2028 as Boulder confronts rising costs and cuts across its recreation system.
